I answered Pree in a thread on their #central-team message: the store was **Pine Crossing**.

That comes from Pree's own Jun 9 message in #central-team. They wrote that Pine Crossing's morning receiver could only see the afternoon shift on the appointment screen, and a driver who arrived at 7:10 was logged on a sticky note. Hollis replied that he'd check the shift template.

I couldn't find a site code or address for Pine Crossing in any file I can see, so the reply tells Pree they'll need the account records for anything beyond the store name.
